metadata.description: A weathered trading post where storm glass and salt provisions change hands. Shelves hold relics of the old world and necessities of the new.
A compact merchant's den where brine-cured goods and scavenged curiosities line the walls. The counter bears the marks of countless transactions.
A weathered waystation where salt-worn travelers find respite. The counter bears scars from countless storm-glass mugs, and the beds offer sanctuary from the endless glare.
A pilgrim's hall where the common room echoes with tales of distant shrines. Long tables bear the weight of shared meals and whispered rumors of storm-touched ruins.
A spacious dwelling with separate chambers for rest and work. Salt-traders once counted their wealth in these rooms, their ledgers now dust beneath the shelves.
A dwelling with extensive storage chambers below the living quarters. Storm glass and preserved provisions fill the lower vaults, awaiting the next caravan season.
Chambers divided by weathered stone speak of prosperity earned through storm-seasons. Two hearths, two lives intertwined beneath the glass-scarred sky.
A dwelling built around an inner courtyard where glass shards catch morning light. The central space offers respite from the steppe's endless winds.
A modest dwelling where salt-worn stones shelter simple comforts. The bed bears witness to dreams of distant storms.
Stone walls embrace a pilgrim's refuge. Shelves hold fragments of scripture and memories of clearer days.
A modest shrine where salt-stained pilgrims kneel before altars of fused glass. The stone bears witness to countless prayers for safe passage through the storm-carved wastes.
A contemplation chamber where the faithful seek clarity in silence. Open space surrounds the sacred altar, allowing light to refract through storm-glass windows in patterns of divine geometry.
A vitrified hall where salt-sworn magistrates hold court beneath storm-glass windows. The throne bears the scars of three dynasties.
A council chamber where pilgrim voices echo off salt-stained walls. Here, the weight of collective judgment settles disputes.

A fortified data vault where the ArchiveDrones store their most precious pre-cataclysm records. Reinforced brick walls protect countless shelves of vitrified scripture shards and crystallized memory cores.

A climate-controlled preservation chamber where delicate artifacts are maintained in perfect stasis. Specialized lamps provide precise illumination while archivists tend to organized shelves of ancient knowledge.

A scholarly repository where ArchiveDrones study and transcribe recovered knowledge. Tables and chairs provide workspace for scribes while towering shelves hold countless volumes of preserved wisdom from the world that was.
Workbenches ring this crystalline forge where Glassborn artisans shape storm glass into tools and ornaments. The air shimmers with heat and the sound of careful hammering on vitrified surfaces.

Glass walls filter light into this clinic where Glassborn undergo voluntary refraction adaptations. Shelves hold crystalline instruments while workbenches serve as examination tables for those embracing transformation.

Crystalline statues catch and scatter light through glass walls in this gallery. Glassborn display their finest refractive art here, celebrating the beauty found in voluntary transformation and vitrified flesh.
A sacred temple where MirrorMonks focus light through glass walls onto twin altars. The vitrified chambers amplify their reverent meditations on the nature of refraction.
A sparse chamber for silent contemplation. Here, MirrorMonks practice the discipline of inner refraction, seeking clarity through emptiness and the gentle glow of a single lamp.
Sacred texts line the shelves of this archive, their glass-etched scripture shards catching lamplight. MirrorMonks preserve the luminous wisdom of their order within these hallowed walls.
A cramped hideaway where refraction outcasts seek shelter from persecution. The sparse furnishings speak of desperate lives lived in the shadows, away from the judgment of the unchanged.
A clandestine medical facility where outcasts tend to their own. Crude surgical tools and glass-shard remedies line the shelves, while the examination bed bears stains from desperate procedures.
A hidden trading post where outcasts exchange forbidden goods and services. Counters display contraband items while the central table serves for hushed negotiations away from the authorities' gaze.
Salt-stained counters display rare goods from distant caravans. The air tastes of brine and distant storms, carrying whispers of profitable ventures.
Weary travelers rest on salt-crusted bedrolls while their goods await the next storm's passing. Maps mark safe routes through the ever-shifting glass.
Crystalline brine pools in sealed containers, their surfaces reflecting distorted images of stored relics. The warehouse hums with the value of accumulated trade.
A vitrified workshop where SandEngineers forge precision instruments from storm-tempered metals. The rhythmic hammering echoes through reinforced walls.
Molten glass and metal flow through channels carved in salt-resistant stone. The foundry's heat warps the air, bending light into prismatic fragments.
Precise instruments measure the refraction of storm glass. Shelves hold crystalline components that hum with barely contained energies.
A simple shrine where storm cultists gather to commune with the tempest. The central altar bears scorch marks from lightning strikes, and the air hums with residual electrical energy.
An open ceremonial space where storm cultists perform their chaotic rituals. Twin altars mark the center, and the minimal walls allow the wild winds to flow freely through the sacred space.

A fortified observation post where storm cultists track the movements of glass tempests. Charts and storm-glass instruments line the shelves, while the watcher maintains vigil for the next great storm.

A crystalline shrine dedicated to the Mirror Saints

A magnificent city of crystalline spires and refracted light
A trading port built around ancient salt mines and brine pools

A sacred site where Mirror Monks commune with reflected light
A data storage facility from the pre-storm era, still partially functional
A towering crystal spire that bends light into impossible patterns
A monument to those lost in the great glass storms
A dangerous tear in reality where the void seeps through
